evidence: A satisfying settlement authorizes the run, assigns 2 certified operators, sets validation to 50 parts, requires the measurement-system check, schedules a 90-minute repair, includes staffing and terminal-repair work-order commitments, and uses revealed PF2 in justification_fact_ids. A plausible uninformed settlement based only on the pilot could authorize with one certified operator and omit the exact validation, measurement, and repair controls, failing multiple checks.
